# hetznerrobot_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Lists every SSH key stored in Robot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_ssh_keys" "all" {}

output "fingerprints" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_ssh_keys.all.keys[*].fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The SSH keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation date.
- `data` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format.
- `fingerprint` (String) MD5 fingerprint of the key.
- `name` (String) Name of the key.
- `size` (Number) Key size in bits.
- `type` (String) Key algorithm, e.g. `ED25519`.
